source_pr_title: fix(cli): cleanup treats review-host auth as a warning, not a gate (bro-owg)
author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**WARNING:** New degrade paths have no tests — the destructive command's behavior changed without coverage

`cleanup.test.ts` covers only the pure `planCleanup` core; nothing exercises the two paths this PR adds:

1. A throwing `loadBroConfig()` must degrade to `prefer: undefined` and still reach the keep-all plan — the exact bug this commit fixes (config load aborting cleanup) has no regression test.
2. When `facadeAuth` returns a remediation line (offline or unauthenticated), the run must continue into the try/catch and land on the empty-map fallback, keeping every branch. The old `ensureAuth` exited(1), so no existing test asserts the new continue path either.

On a command whose failure mode is deleting local branches, these are the highest-value assertions: a run against a temp repo with an unauthenticated host should exit 0, print the keep-all plan, and delete nothing.

---
Reply with `@kilocode-bot fix it` to have Kilo Code address this issue.
